Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 38 Dulwich Hill Commercial Precinct 38 - with IWLEP 2022 amendments

Clause 9.38.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.38.2 - heritage (development_control): To retain, as a minimum, the front portion of contributory buildings where they are contributory to the heritage conservation area (HCA) and streetscapes.

Clause 9.38.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified heritage values of the Dulwich Hill Commercial Precinct Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.38.2 - height_limit (development_control): To ensure that new development at rear upper levels is a maximum of four storeys in appearance and is designed to be subservient to retained portions of contributory buildings or infill development to the street building front.

Clause 9.38.2 - other (development_control): To facilitate efficient parking, loading and access for vehicles that minimises impact to streetscape appearance, commercial viability and vitality and pedestrian safety and amenity.

Clause 9.38.3 - heritage (development_control): The precinct contains HCA 28 Dulwich Hill Commercial Precinct Heritage Conservation Area. See Part 8 (Heritage) of this DCP for detailed controls and guidelines.

Clause C1 - heritage (development_control): HCA 28 Dulwich Hill Commercial Precinct Heritage Conservation Area has been identified as containing the following streetscapes: a. Retail Streetscapes. Refer to Section 8.4 of this DCP for relevant controls.
